glm-5p3-flash.note: GLM-5.3 (glm-5p3) does not accept images; Flash is the image-capable GLM 5.3 model. Every way to disable thinking (reasoning_effort none, thinking disabled, enable_thinking false) returns HTTP 400 'Invalid image or video input', so reasoning_effort is 'low' (as for Glimmer). The grammar still constrains the output to exactly 3 actions (~25 tokens), but Fireworks returns it as reasoning_content with content empty, so the answer is read from reasoning_content when content is empty.
